activation_policy: STAGED geometry may be explicitly previewed; REAL planning requires confirmed physical mounting and accepted collision coverage.

wire.tip_definition: CAD gun-tip reference point of the supplied welding_gun_source.STL; model-defined, not physical measurement
wire.parameters_source: applied real_tcp_calibration_applied.json + CAD gun-tip reference; wire terminates on the TCP display sphere surface, not at its centre
wire.collision_model: fixed cylinder child of WeldingGunMount from gun tip to the TCP marker sphere surface
wire.reason: Operator explicitly requested a simplified straight 1.2 mm cylinder from the recorded CAD tip to confirmed planning TCP; not a certified physical nozzle axis. LIVE display follows controller TCP; planning requires synchronized TCP calibration.
wire.axis_definition: normalized(gun_tip -> TCP centre) in STL_SOURCE; endpoint shortened by tcp_marker_radius_m along this axis
wire.length_definition: Euclidean distance between tip_source and wire_end_source
wire.contact_definition: wire_end_source = tcp_source - tcp_marker_radius_m * normalized(tcp_source - tip_source); visual contact with the red LIVE TCP marker

unit_assessment.method: size heuristic only; source mesh is not modified

stl_audit_summary.contains_l_bracket: visual inspection required; mesh includes the L-shaped bracket in the supplied STL preview
